name: opp_initech_001
title: Initech Solutions - Core Ops Suite (initial deployment)

notes.note: This is a momentum/engagement risk, not a pricing or competitive one — no competitor has been mentioned and no discount has been discussed, because the deal never reached a commercial conversation. The champion (Neha Kapoor) was enthusiastic during the demo but has since gone quiet. Win probability has been revised down to reflect the stall. Recommended action is re-engagement outreach, not a pricing lever.

opportunity_risk_factors.description: No substantive activity or reply from Initech since the 2026-07-28 demo call; over 30 days of silence as of 2026-09-04.
No follow-up meeting is on the calendar. Two follow-up emails (2026-08-05, 2026-08-20) have gone unanswered.
The economic buyer (Suresh Bhatia, VP Operations) was copied on the initial demo invite but has never independently engaged.
